translations.name: NJ pharmacist-furnished contraception
translations.description: In New Jersey you can get birth control directly from a pharmacist. There is no age limit, no income test and no insurance needed. About 150 pharmacies in all 21 counties take part. You can get a 3-month supply the same day. See the NJ Department of Health pharmacy list to find one.
translations.website_description: Learn about family planning and sexual health care.
